kind: analyze (extract reconstruction fields from a relaxed classical-MD moire; no DFT, no structure build)
provenance: values from 3_reproduction/L1/result.json and auditor/analyze.py (the extraction our ground truth came from: local strain from 6-nearest W-W neighbors, registry from the nearest opposite-layer W in the WS2 monolayer basis, radius binning of the fields). Ground truth is OUR reproduction on the staged relaxed structure; the paper's Fig. 1 colorbar is the fidelity check, not the graded number.
staged_input: agent/lammps.dat_min (relaxed), agent/lammps.dat (rigid), agent/kc.dump (per-atom interlayer energy on the relaxed structure)

eps_WS2_curve.rule: The three-locale WS2 strain is graded as one curve, per-point tol_i = max(0.10*|truth_i|, floor), floor = 0.10*max|truth| = 0.0789 %. Signs are PHYSICAL and graded (not convention-soft): WS2 is compressive at R^h_h, tensile at R^X_h/R^M_h.

eps_WSe2_curve.rule: The three-locale paired-WSe2 strain is graded as one curve, floor = 0.10*max|truth| = 0.1372 %. Signs PHYSICAL and graded: WSe2 tensile at R^h_h, compressive at R^X_h/R^M_h (opposite to WS2).

d.rule: Each interlayer distance within 10% of the true value (all three clearly nonzero, similar scale). PLUS a relation: d(R^h_h) is the maximum of the three (an exact ordering guard; the reproduction guard G3). The +/-10% value band is loose here because the three d differ by <10%, so the max-location relation is the discriminator.

corrugation.rule: Each layer corrugation (W z peak-to-peak) within 10% of the true value.

adhesion.rule: Each per-locale adhesion within 10% of the true value (all clearly nonzero; sign PHYSICAL, all negative = attractive/bound). PLUS a relation: R^X_h is the minimum (most negative) and R^h_h the maximum (least negative) -- the adhesion-landscape ordering (reproduction guard G1). For three points, argmin==R^X_h and argmax==R^h_h fixes the full order R^X_h < R^M_h < R^h_h.
adhesion.relation: adhesion_RXh_eV < adhesion_RMh_eV < adhesion_Rhh_eV (R^X_h lowest, R^h_h highest)

domain_area.rule: Each of the four area fractions within 10% of the true value (all clearly nonzero). PLUS the reconstruction-signature relations (reproduction guard G5): R^X_h grows on relaxation (relaxed > rigid) and R^h_h shrinks (relaxed < rigid).

score: 1 only if ALL primary checks pass (all checks must pass; any single failure scores 0): (a) the two 3-point strain curves (signs included), (b) the three d values + d(R^h_h) is max, (c) the two corrugations, (d) the three adhesion values + the R^X_h-lowest/R^h_h-highest ordering, (e) the four domain fractions + the R^X_h-grows/R^h_h-shrinks relations.

self_check_2026-07-03.direction1_our_reproduction_as_submissio: Reference and independent solutions pass. RXh relaxed area differs by roughly one site in near-degenerate nearest-opposite-W pairing; 103/676 versus stored 104/676 remains inside the existing band. This is not established as a radius-boundary rounding effect.
designed_wrong_must_fail: WS2 strain signs flipped -> eps_WS2_curve fails
WS2/WSe2 strain locale fields swapped between layers -> both strain curves fail
d(R^h_h) not the max (R^X_h reported largest) -> d relation fails
adhesion order permuted (R^X_h reported least negative) -> adhesion relation fails
domain growth reversed (R^X_h shrinks) -> domain relation + area values fail
